name: Blex
description: An oversized escaped pest once used for hazing who died in the invasion.

timeline.summary: Blex is killed in the invasion and, soon after, a lookalike, Blech, appears.
timeline.quote: Finally, Blex was retrieved in the most tragic way possible: as a victim of the Phyrexian Invasion.
